dialogues.en:
I pick up my empty bag. I usually keep all of my schoolbooks
inside of my desk.
dialogues.text:
I pick up my empty bag. I usually keep all of my schoolbooks
inside of my desk.

dialogues.jp:
という間に、１日の授業が終わった。環境が変
わった事で、時間が早く流れたらしい。
dialogues.en: "Things did change in the new grade..."
dialogues.text: "Things did change in the new grade..."

dialogues.jp:
教室の中は既に閑散としている。杉並もどこか
へ消えた。
dialogues.en: I'm murmuring to myself on the way back home.
dialogues.text: I'm murmuring to myself on the way back home.

dialogues.jp: 「さて、帰りますか……」
dialogues.en: "Before it started,I thought nothing would change..."
dialogues.text: "Before it started,I thought nothing would change..."

dialogues.jp: 教科書は机の中にそのままに、鞄をかつぐ。
dialogues.en:
There are new people in each classroom, and different
teachers, but the biggest change is that Nemu isn't there.
dialogues.text:
There are new people in each classroom, and different
teachers, but the biggest change is that Nemu isn't there.

dialogues.jp:
「やっぱ、本校に上がって、それなりに変わっ
　ちまったよなあ……」
dialogues.en:
I saw her off with a smile, but I miss her. We had been
always together for 10 years......
dialogues.text:
I saw her off with a smile, but I miss her. We had been
always together for 10 years......

dialogues.jp: 並木道をてくてく歩きながら、一人ごちる。
dialogues.en: "......I don't have to go straight home."
dialogues.text: "......I don't have to go straight home."

dialogues.jp:
「入学する前は、ほとんど何も変わらないと思っ
　てたのに……」
dialogues.en:
I was gonna go straight home, but I've changed my mind. I
turn around and start to walk in the opposite direction.
dialogues.text:
I was gonna go straight home, but I've changed my mind. I
turn around and start to walk in the opposite direction.

dialogues.jp:
教室の顔ぶれが違う。授業内容が違う。そして
何より、音夢が居ない。
dialogues.en: "This place never seems to change......"
dialogues.text: "This place never seems to change......"

dialogues.jp:
笑顔で送り出したとは言え、やはり寂しさを感
じてしまう。
dialogues.en:
The petals of cherry blossom are falling down from the sky
as I look around. This place is always covered in pink.
dialogues.text:
The petals of cherry blossom are falling down from the sky
as I look around. This place is always covered in pink.

dialogues.jp: ま、１０年来一緒だったもんな……。
dialogues.en:
I spend a while absently watching cherry blossoms, but some
little kids' ear-piercing voices pull me back to reality.
dialogues.text:
I spend a while absently watching cherry blossoms, but some
little kids' ear-piercing voices pull me back to reality.

dialogues.jp: 「……どっか、寄ってくか」
dialogues.en:
"Over there, over there! There's a weirdo sitting on the
bench."
dialogues.text:
"Over there, over there! There's a weirdo sitting on the
bench."

dialogues.jp:
まっすぐ家に帰ろうと思っていたが、気が変わっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Three little devils come running towards the end of Sakura
Park.
dialogues.text:
Three little devils come running towards the end of Sakura
Park.

dialogues.jp: 俺の足が、くるっと方向転換する。
dialogues.en: (A weirdo?)
dialogues.text: (A weirdo?)

dialogues.jp: 「ここは、いつまでも変わらないよなあ……」
dialogues.en: I follow the boys out of curiosity.
dialogues.text: I follow the boys out of curiosity.

dialogues.jp:
舞い散る桜の花びらに目を細め、辺りを見回す。
いつ見ても、ピンクに染められている。
dialogues.en: "Look there. See? See? A weirdo, huh?"
dialogues.text: "Look there. See? See? A weirdo, huh?"

dialogues.jp:
しばらく、ぼうっと桜を眺めていたのだが、ガ
キのキンキン声で現実に引き戻された。
dialogues.en:
One of the kids is talking excitedly to the others beside
him.
dialogues.text:
One of the kids is talking excitedly to the others beside
him.

dialogues.jp:
３人連れのいかにもな悪ガキが、桜公園の奥へ
と走り去っていくところだった。
dialogues.en:
I didn't run like they did, but my long legs got me here
right after they did.
dialogues.text:
I didn't run like they did, but my long legs got me here
right after they did.

dialogues.jp: （変な奴？）
dialogues.en: (A weirdo......? Why...?)
dialogues.text: (A weirdo......? Why...?)

dialogues.jp:
好奇心を刺激され、悪ガキの背中を目標に歩を
進めた。
dialogues.en: But saying that, it is kind of weird...
dialogues.text: But saying that, it is kind of weird...

dialogues.jp:
ガキの一人が、両側のガキに向かって、しきり
にまくし立てる。
dialogues.en:
A girl, wearing blue clothes, is sitting and hugging her
knees on the bench. The way she sits is weird, but also...
dialogues.text:
A girl, wearing blue clothes, is sitting and hugging her
knees on the bench. The way she sits is weird, but also...

dialogues.jp:
足のコンパスの違いか、急がなかったのに普通
に追いつけたらしい。
dialogues.en: Is she wearing a maid costume?
dialogues.text: Is she wearing a maid costume?

dialogues.jp: （変……？　どこがだ？）
dialogues.en:
But she looks younger than me, and I don't think she knows
what a maid costume is all about.
dialogues.text:
But she looks younger than me, and I don't think she knows
what a maid costume is all about.

dialogues.jp: いや、確かに変と言われれば変ではある。
dialogues.en: "No, there's no way she knows. I mean, neither do I..."
dialogues.text: "No, there's no way she knows. I mean, neither do I..."

dialogues.jp:
何やら、青っぽい服を着た少女が、ベンチの上
で膝を抱えて座っているのだ。その姿勢もさる
ことながら──、
dialogues.en:
As I talk ironically to myself, one of the kids comes
towards me.
dialogues.text:
As I talk ironically to myself, one of the kids comes
towards me.

dialogues.jp: ──メイド服か？
dialogues.en:
"It's true! It is true! She has something weird on her
head!"
dialogues.text:
"It's true! It is true! She has something weird on her
head!"

dialogues.jp:
しかし、どう見ても俺より年下にしか見えない
この子が、メイド服の何たるかを知っていると
いうのか？
dialogues.en:
"She must be a monster! Let's kill the monster! We can take
care of it!"
dialogues.text:
"She must be a monster! Let's kill the monster! We can take
care of it!"

dialogues.jp: 「いや、知らぬはず。つーか、俺も知らん」

などと反語を呟く間にも、｛せっこう／斥候｝に飛んでいった
一人のガキが、こちらへと戻ってきた。
dialogues.en:
This doesn't look or sound good. The kids start running
aggressively towards the girl.
dialogues.text:
This doesn't look or sound good. The kids start running
aggressively towards the girl.

dialogues.jp:
何やら雲行きが妖しくなってきた。ガキどもは
好戦的な表情で、少女に向かって走っていく。
dialogues.en: "Oh great, what have I got myself into?"
dialogues.text: "Oh great, what have I got myself into?"

dialogues.jp: 「やれやれ……。かったるいなあ」
dialogues.en: It's a real pain that I have to deal with this situation.
dialogues.text: It's a real pain that I have to deal with this situation.

dialogues.jp:
きな臭い場面に出くわしてしまった、という事
が、かったるい。
dialogues.en: I give a sigh and follow the kids. This time I run.
dialogues.text: I give a sigh and follow the kids. This time I run.

dialogues.jp:
俺はひとつため息をつくと、ガキの後を追った。
今度は、走って。
dialogues.en: "Are you trying to be like Muhammad Ali?"
dialogues.text: "Are you trying to be like Muhammad Ali?"

dialogues.jp: 拳の代わりに、石を使っているが。
dialogues.en: Instead of fists, they're using stones.
dialogues.text: Instead of fists, they're using stones.

dialogues.jp:
少女の回りをぶんぶんと走り回り、ガキどもは
石を投げつけているのだ。
dialogues.en: They're running around the girl and throwing stones at her.
dialogues.text: They're running around the girl and throwing stones at her.

dialogues.jp:
ベンチの少女──メイドさんはと言うと、ただ
頭を抱えているだけだった。
dialogues.en:
The girl on the bench... the maid girl is just sitting there
holding her head down.
dialogues.text:
The girl on the bench... the maid girl is just sitting there
holding her head down.

dialogues.jp: （とんでもねえな。ガキとは言え）
dialogues.en: (They're just kids, but this is out of control.)
dialogues.text: (They're just kids, but this is out of control.)

dialogues.jp: 「おらっ！！　そこまでっ！！」
dialogues.en: "Hey!! Stop it now!!"
dialogues.text: "Hey!! Stop it now!!"

dialogues.jp:
一喝に、だるまさんが転んだよろしく、こちら
を見つめる３対の瞳。
dialogues.en:
Responding to my raised voice, three of them stop dead in
their tracks and look at me.
dialogues.text:
Responding to my raised voice, three of them stop dead in
their tracks and look at me.

dialogues.jp: 「石投げつけるとは穏やかじゃねえぞ？」
dialogues.en: "It's not nice to throw stones at people."
dialogues.text: "It's not nice to throw stones at people."

dialogues.jp: なるべく怖い顔を作ってみせる。
dialogues.en: I make an angry face at them.
dialogues.text: I make an angry face at them.

dialogues.jp:
３人の内ふたりはひよったらしく、手にしてい
た石を地面に落とす。
dialogues.en: Two of the kids drop the stones from their hands.
dialogues.text: Two of the kids drop the stones from their hands.

dialogues.jp:
が、ひとりはますます反抗的な目つきをすると、
ベンチに向かって最後の石を投げつけた。
dialogues.en:
But the other one has a more defiant look on his face, and
throws the last stone he has towards the bench.
dialogues.text:
But the other one has a more defiant look on his face, and
throws the last stone he has towards the bench.

dialogues.jp: 「キャオラァッ！！」
dialogues.en: "Hey, hey! That's enough!!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, hey! That's enough!!"

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.jp: 「びえ〜ん」
dialogues.en: "Uwaaaa~"
dialogues.text: "Uwaaaa~"

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.jp: 「ふ……つまらぬ拳をふるってしまった」
dialogues.en:
"Hah...... you deserved my fist because you just did
something stupid."
dialogues.text:
"Hah...... you deserved my fist because you just did
something stupid."

dialogues.jp:
逃げ去るガキの背中を見つめつつ、渋く決めて
みせる。
dialogues.en: I stand like a hero as I watch them run away.
dialogues.text: I stand like a hero as I watch them run away.

dialogues.jp:
ひとつ息をつき、メイドさんの元に向かう。し
かし、何故にメイド服？
dialogues.en: With a sigh, I turn around and walk toward the maid girl.
dialogues.text: With a sigh, I turn around and walk toward the maid girl.

dialogues.jp: 「ほら、もう平気だよ」
dialogues.en: "You're okay now."
dialogues.text: "You're okay now."

dialogues.jp:
言葉をかけると、しばらくしてから少女は顔を
あげた。ギギギと、重々しい扉の音が聞こえて
きそうなほど、ゆっくりと。
dialogues.en:
She holds her head down for a while, and then looks up, very
slowly, as if her head was a heavy metal door.
dialogues.text:
She holds her head down for a while, and then looks up, very
slowly, as if her head was a heavy metal door.

dialogues.jp: 泣きはらした目。荒れた頬。そして……。
dialogues.en:
Her eyes are puffy and her cheeks are rough from crying,
and...
dialogues.text:
Her eyes are puffy and her cheeks are rough from crying,
and...

dialogues.jp: 頭の部分に、目が釘付けになる。
dialogues.en: My eyes are glued to her head.
dialogues.text: My eyes are glued to her head.

dialogues.jp:
そこには、何というか、その、ネコ耳が生えて
いた。
dialogues.en: How should I call it...? She has... cat's ears on her head.
dialogues.text: How should I call it...? She has... cat's ears on her head.

dialogues.jp: 「……てか、帽子？」
dialogues.en: "......Is that a hat?"
dialogues.text: "......Is that a hat?"

dialogues.jp:
聞こえたのか聞こえないのか、ネコ耳のメイド
さんは視線で俺の顔に穴を開けようとしてくる。
dialogues.en:
I'm not sure if she heard me or not, but the maid girl with
cat ears stares at me as if she could drill a hole on my
face with her eyes.
dialogues.text:
I'm not sure if she heard me or not, but the maid girl with
cat ears stares at me as if she could drill a hole on my
face with her eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「ここ。これ」
dialogues.en: "There. That thing on your head."
dialogues.text: "There. That thing on your head."

dialogues.jp:
自分の頭をこつこつと叩く。メイドさんは、はっ
と目の覚めた顔をして、ネコ耳に指先をやった。
dialogues.en:
I pat my head to show her what I'm talking about. The maid
girl blinks herself out of her trance, and points her finger
to her cat ears.
dialogues.text:
I pat my head to show her what I'm talking about. The maid
girl blinks herself out of her trance, and points her finger
to her cat ears.

dialogues.jp: 「あ……う……こ、これは、その……」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... umm...... Th-These are......"
dialogues.text: "Ah...... umm...... Th-These are......"

dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 「えぅ……と、その、あの……」
「で、ですから……」
dialogues.en: "Y-You know......"
dialogues.text: "Y-You know......"

dialogues.jp: 「ですから？」
dialogues.en: "You mean...?"
dialogues.text: "You mean...?"

dialogues.jp:
何というか、端から見ればサイレント映画だな、
こりゃ。
dialogues.en: This is like a silent movie.
dialogues.text: This is like a silent movie.

dialogues.jp:
メイド服を着た少女は、相当気弱らしく、視線
もろくに合わせようとしない。
dialogues.en:
The maid girl looks very shy and she's not even trying to
look at me.
dialogues.text:
The maid girl looks very shy and she's not even trying to
look at me.

dialogues.jp:
その泣きそうな顔を見ていると、何だか悪い事
をしたみたいな気になってしまう。
dialogues.en:
She looks like she's about to cry, and I feel like I did
something wrong.
dialogues.text:
She looks like she's about to cry, and I feel like I did
something wrong.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ……いいか、耳の事は。俺は、あのガキ
　どもとは違うし……」
dialogues.en:
"Well...... I don't care about your ears. I'm not like those
kids......"
dialogues.text:
"Well...... I don't care about your ears. I'm not like those
kids......"

dialogues.jp:
「ともかく、家に帰った方がいいんじゃないか？
　さっきの石で、怪我とかしてるかもしれない
　しさ」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, I think you should go back to your house. You might
have gotten hurt from the stones they threw at you."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, I think you should go back to your house. You might
have gotten hurt from the stones they threw at you."

dialogues.jp: 「んじゃ、俺はこれで……」
dialogues.en: "So, goodbye......"
dialogues.text: "So, goodbye......"

dialogues.jp:
ネコ耳メイドさんに背を向けて、その場を立ち
去ろうとする。が──。
dialogues.en:
I turn around and start to walk away from the maid girl.
But......
dialogues.text:
I turn around and start to walk away from the maid girl.
But......

dialogues.jp: 「あうう……」
「ちょ、ちょっと？　何よ？」
dialogues.en: "What, what? What's the matter?"
dialogues.text: "What, what? What's the matter?"

dialogues.jp: 「ま、待って。待ってください……」
dialogues.en: "W-Wait. Please wait......"
dialogues.text: "W-Wait. Please wait......"

dialogues.jp:
ぎゅっと、服を掴んでくる。迷子が、ようやく
母親を見つけたような感じで。
dialogues.en:
She grabs my clothes tightly, like a little lost girl who
finally found her mother.
dialogues.text:
She grabs my clothes tightly, like a little lost girl who
finally found her mother.

dialogues.jp: 「あの？　待つって？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.jp: 「あ、えと、だから……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I mean......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, I mean......"

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.jp: 「ママ、あいつだよ！　あいつがぶったんだ！」
dialogues.en: "Mom, that's him! He hit me on my head!"
dialogues.text: "Mom, that's him! He hit me on my head!"

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.jp: 「んげ」
dialogues.en: "Shoot."
dialogues.text: "Shoot."

dialogues.jp:
さっき、俺の鉄拳の餌食となったガキが、母親
らしき人物の手を引き舞い戻ってきた。
dialogues.en: The kid that I hit earlier comes back with his mother.
dialogues.text: The kid that I hit earlier comes back with his mother.

dialogues.jp: 「逃げるか」
dialogues.en: "It's time to run!"
dialogues.text: "It's time to run!"

dialogues.jp:
離れそうもないので、メイドさんの手を引き、
ダッシュをかます。
dialogues.en:
It didn't seem like she was going to let go of my hand, so I
take her hand and run.
dialogues.text:
It didn't seem like she was going to let go of my hand, so I
take her hand and run.

dialogues.jp: 後ろ足で砂を引っかけるって奴だな。
dialogues.en: This is what's called 'a high-speed chase'.
dialogues.text: This is what's called 'a high-speed chase'.

dialogues.jp:
背後から、母親とガキのキイキイ声が追ってき
た。
dialogues.en:
The kid and his mother are screaming from behind as they
chase me.
dialogues.text:
The kid and his mother are screaming from behind as they
chase me.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.en: "Stop!!"
dialogues.text: "Stop!!"

dialogues.en: "Haah, haah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah, haah..."

dialogues.jp: 「はあ、はあ、ふう、はあ……」
dialogues.en: "Hah, hah, phew, hah..."
dialogues.text: "Hah, hah, phew, hah..."

dialogues.jp:
「はあ、ふう、はあ……。ここまでくれば大丈
　夫か」
dialogues.en: "Hah, haahh...... I think we're safe now."
dialogues.text: "Hah, haahh...... I think we're safe now."

dialogues.jp:
犯罪人のような台詞を吐きつつ、周囲を見渡す。
桜色に埋め尽くされた道にあの母子の姿はない。
dialogues.en:
I speak like a dangerous fugitive as I look around. I can't
see the kid or his mother on the road that's covered with
cherry blossom petals.
dialogues.text:
I speak like a dangerous fugitive as I look around. I can't
see the kid or his mother on the road that's covered with
cherry blossom petals.

dialogues.jp: 「おっとと。手を握ったままだったか。わり」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I'm sorry. I kept holding your hand."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I'm sorry. I kept holding your hand."

dialogues.jp: メイドさんの手を放す。
dialogues.en: I let her hand go.
dialogues.text: I let her hand go.

dialogues.jp:
途端に不安げな顔。カナヅチが浮き輪を失った
ような。……何で？
dialogues.en:
She looks anxious all of a sudden. She looks like a girl who
can't swim and just lost her floater. ...But... why?
dialogues.text:
She looks anxious all of a sudden. She looks like a girl who
can't swim and just lost her floater. ...But... why?

dialogues.jp: 「あのさ、俺に何か用なの？」
dialogues.en: "Can I help you?"
dialogues.text: "Can I help you?"

dialogues.jp:
真夏の雪だるまのような、どうにも放っておけ
ない危うさがある。
dialogues.en:
She's like a snowman in midsummer. I just can't leave her
alone.
dialogues.text:
She's like a snowman in midsummer. I just can't leave her
alone.

dialogues.jp:
さっさと立ち去ればいいのだが、そうした途端、
この世から溶け消えてしまう、そんな不安感を
覚えるのだ。
dialogues.en:
I even felt like if I turn around and leave her, she'd melt
away from this world.
dialogues.text:
I even felt like if I turn around and leave her, she'd melt
away from this world.

dialogues.jp: ほんと、かったるい……。
dialogues.en: This is a real pain...
dialogues.text: This is a real pain...

dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの、私は……私……」

視線を逸らしつつ口ごもる。俺は小さく息をつ
いた。
dialogues.en: She murmurs, not looking at me. I give a small sigh.
dialogues.text: She murmurs, not looking at me. I give a small sigh.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、とりあえず自己紹介しようか。俺は朝倉
　[name]。君は？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, let me introduce myself to start with. My name's
Asakura Asakura. What's yours?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, let me introduce myself to start with. My name's
Asakura Asakura. What's yours?"

dialogues.jp:
何かしら意外だったらしく、メイドさんが目を
見張る。つーか、自己紹介でそんなに驚くか？
dialogues.en:
It seemed like that's something she wasn't expecting to
hear, and she looks right at me. But why's she so surprised
by my introduction?
dialogues.text:
It seemed like that's something she wasn't expecting to
hear, and she looks right at me. But why's she so surprised
by my introduction?

dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの……私、私は……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I... my name is......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, I... my name is......"

dialogues.jp: 間。そして、彼女は言った。
dialogues.en: There's a silence, and she says...
dialogues.text: There's a silence, and she says...

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私は……頼子、です。｛さぎさわ／鷺澤｝｛よりこ／頼子｝……」
dialogues.en: "My name is......Yoriko. Yoriko Sagisawa......"
dialogues.text: "My name is......Yoriko. Yoriko Sagisawa......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
その名前には聞き覚えがあった。思わず眉根に
しわが寄ってしまう。
dialogues.en: The name sounds familiar to me. I furrow my brows.
dialogues.text: The name sounds familiar to me. I furrow my brows.

dialogues.en: "Yoriko......?"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの、何か……？」

俺の反応に、叱られたように首をすくめる頼子
さん。
dialogues.en:
Yoriko-san ducks her head, like a little kid being yelled at
by her mother.
dialogues.text:
Yoriko-san ducks her head, like a little kid being yelled at
by her mother.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、いや、ははは。何でもない」
dialogues.en: "Ah, no. Hahaha. Nothing."
dialogues.text: "Ah, no. Hahaha. Nothing."

dialogues.jp:
そう、それは例の夢で耳にした名前だ。けれど、
それを他人に言う訳にはいかなかった。
dialogues.en:
Yes, it's the name I heard in the dream, but I can't tell
her about that.
dialogues.text:
Yes, it's the name I heard in the dream, but I can't tell
her about that.

dialogues.jp: （しかし、頼子、ね。ってことは……）
dialogues.en: (But if her name is Yoriko, that means......)
dialogues.text: (But if her name is Yoriko, that means......)

dialogues.jp: 思わず、頭の耳にぶしつけな視線を送る。
dialogues.en: I throw a rude look at her ears on her head.
dialogues.text: I throw a rude look at her ears on her head.

dialogues.jp:
胸の谷間でも覗かれたように顔を赤くする。俺
の右手がわきわきした。
dialogues.en:
Her face turns red as if I was looking at her cleavage, and
I feel a little tickle on my right hand.
dialogues.text:
Her face turns red as if I was looking at her cleavage, and
I feel a little tickle on my right hand.

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、それ……本物？」
dialogues.en: "Are those...... real?"
dialogues.text: "Are those...... real?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「それとも、時代の｛せんたん／尖端｝を行くアヴァンギャル
　ドなアクセサリか？」
dialogues.en: "Or are they the latest fashion accessories?"
dialogues.text: "Or are they the latest fashion accessories?"

dialogues.jp:
｛かぶん／寡聞｝にして、ネコ耳なるアクセサリが流行って
るなんて聞いた事がない。
dialogues.en:
I've never heard of a trend to wear cat ears as an
accessory.
dialogues.text:
I've never heard of a trend to wear cat ears as an
accessory.

dialogues.jp: 「……むう、辛抱たまらん。ちょっと、失礼」
dialogues.en: "......Umm, I can't help it. Please let me."
dialogues.text: "......Umm, I can't help it. Please let me."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en:
I feel like a molester or something, but I touch her cat
ears.
dialogues.text:
I feel like a molester or something, but I touch her cat
ears.

dialogues.jp:
触れた瞬間、ぴくんと動いた……。しかも、血
が通っているかのように、温かい。
さらに触る。
dialogues.en:
As I touch it, it twitches...... And it's so warm, like it
has blood circulation.
dialogues.text:
As I touch it, it twitches...... And it's so warm, like it
has blood circulation.

dialogues.jp: ぴくぴく。ぴくぴく。
dialogues.en: (Her cat ears are twitching.)
dialogues.text: (Her cat ears are twitching.)

dialogues.jp:
耳を解放し、自分の手を目の前でまじまじと見
つめる。
dialogues.en:
I release her ear from my hand and I stare at my hand
closely.
dialogues.text:
I release her ear from my hand and I stare at my hand
closely.

dialogues.jp: あの感触は、確かに嘘じゃない。
dialogues.en: Those ears are definitely real.
dialogues.text: Those ears are definitely real.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はあ、はあ、ふう、……ん」
dialogues.en: "Haah, haah... umm... umm."
dialogues.text: "Haah, haah... umm... umm."

dialogues.jp: 微妙な息切れを整え、頼子さんは言った。
dialogues.en: She tries to catch her breath and says,
dialogues.text: She tries to catch her breath and says,

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの……耳は、本物です」
dialogues.en: "Ah, ah...... these ears are real."
dialogues.text: "Ah, ah...... these ears are real."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: （餅は本物力もち……）
dialogues.en: (A deer is dear for real......)
dialogues.text: (A deer is dear for real......)

dialogues.jp:
｛とっさ／咄嗟｝に浮かんだＣＭのフレーズを、そのまま飲
み下す。緊張の余り、頭がやわになってるな。
dialogues.en:
I heard this phrase on a TV commercial, and it just popped
into my head. I think my brain is turning soft because of
this tension.
dialogues.text:
I heard this phrase on a TV commercial, and it just popped
into my head. I think my brain is turning soft because of
this tension.

dialogues.jp: 「ほ、本物……だって？」

くわっ。まさか。そんな。アレな。いやいや。
でも、ほんとに？
dialogues.en: What? @
dialogues.text: What? @

dialogues.jp:
俺の目の前に立つのは、ネコ耳メイドさんなの
かっ！
dialogues.en: No way! @
dialogues.text: No way! @

dialogues.jp: と、ふと視線を感じた。
dialogues.en: It can't be. @
dialogues.text: It can't be. @

dialogues.jp:
首を巡らせると、本校の制服を着た女子数人が
こちらを見ているのに気が付いた。
dialogues.en: Really? @
dialogues.text: Really? @

dialogues.jp:
どうやら通学路の真ん中に突っ立っているのが
珍しいらしい。しかも片方はメイド服だ。
dialogues.en: No! @
dialogues.text: No! @

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんの声が後ろから聞こえた。と、背中の
服が引っ張られる感触。どうも、視線を嫌がっ
ているらしい。
dialogues.en:
I hear Yoriko-san's voice from behind me and feel the back
of my clothes being pulled. It seems like she's
uncomfortable with the girls staring at us.
dialogues.text:
I hear Yoriko-san's voice from behind me and feel the back
of my clothes being pulled. It seems like she's
uncomfortable with the girls staring at us.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、女子グループにメンチを切った。嫌そう
な顔で、それでも足早になる女子達。
dialogues.en:
So I glare fiercely at the girls. They frown slightly and
quickly walk away.
dialogues.text:
So I glare fiercely at the girls. They frown slightly and
quickly walk away.

dialogues.jp: 「ふう……全く」
dialogues.en: "Sigh...... Girls."
dialogues.text: "Sigh...... Girls."

dialogues.jp: 振り返るのと、同時に声が聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en: When I turn around, I hear a voice.
dialogues.text: When I turn around, I hear a voice.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほんと、礼儀を知らん連中だよな」
dialogues.en: "They have no manners."
dialogues.text: "They have no manners."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「のわっ」
dialogues.en: "Wow!"
dialogues.text: "Wow!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おお。お前って奴は、ほんとに教科書通りの
　驚き方をするよなあ」
dialogues.en: "You're always jumpy, like a cartoon character."
dialogues.text: "You're always jumpy, like a cartoon character."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「訳のわからん感心をするな。と言うか、いつ
　からそこに立っていた？」
dialogues.en:
"You sound impressed. Anyway, how long have you been
standing there?"
dialogues.text:
"You sound impressed. Anyway, how long have you been
standing there?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「３０秒ほど前だ。まあ、そんな事はどうでも
　いい」
dialogues.en: "For about 30 seconds. It doesn't matter."
dialogues.text: "For about 30 seconds. It doesn't matter."

dialogues.jp:
と、またまた俺の背後に隠れていた頼子さんに
向け、びゅしっと指を突き立てた。
dialogues.en:
He dramatically points his finger at Yoriko-san, who's
hiding on my back.
dialogues.text:
He dramatically points his finger at Yoriko-san, who's
hiding on my back.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「見よっ。生きた奇跡が！　リアルミステリー
　がそこに立って、息をしているのだぞっ！」
dialogues.en:
"Look! A living miracle, a real mystery, is standing
breathing right here!"
dialogues.text:
"Look! A living miracle, a real mystery, is standing
breathing right here!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「くあ〜……ネコ耳とはっ。俺は参った。盲点
　だった！」
dialogues.en: "Man!! Cat ears! You won, dude! I didn't think about that!"
dialogues.text: "Man!! Cat ears! You won, dude! I didn't think about that!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、落ち着けや。頼子さんが嫌がる」
dialogues.en: "Calm down. Yoriko-san doesn't like it."
dialogues.text: "Calm down. Yoriko-san doesn't like it."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おお、これは失礼」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あ〜と、頼子さん。こいつは杉並って言って、
　まあ、俺のダチみたいなもん」
dialogues.en:
"Umm, Yoriko-san. His name is Suginami, and he's kind of my
friend."
dialogues.text:
"Umm, Yoriko-san. His name is Suginami, and he's kind of my
friend."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「みたいなではなく、正真正銘の友だろう」
dialogues.en: "Not 'kind of'. I am your friend in all truth."
dialogues.text: "Not 'kind of'. I am your friend in all truth."

dialogues.jp: 杉並を無視し、頼子さんに語りかける。
dialogues.en: "......Well, he's not a bad guy. So don't worry."
dialogues.text: "......Well, he's not a bad guy. So don't worry."

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんはこくんと頷くと、俺の背中から出て
きた。
dialogues.en:
I ignore Suginami and talk to Yoriko-san. She nods quietly
and comes out around from my back.
dialogues.text:
I ignore Suginami and talk to Yoriko-san. She nods quietly
and comes out around from my back.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの……鷺澤頼子です」
dialogues.en: "Ah... my name is Yoriko Sagisawa."
dialogues.text: "Ah... my name is Yoriko Sagisawa."

dialogues.jp: ぺこりと頭をさげる。
dialogues.en: She bows her head.
dialogues.text: She bows her head.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おお、これはご丁寧にどうも。俺は、杉並と
　言います。杉ちゃんとでも呼んでください」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, it's my pleasure to meet you. My name is Suginami. You
can call me Sugi-chan."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, it's my pleasure to meet you. My name is Suginami. You
can call me Sugi-chan."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「誰が呼ぶかっ」
dialogues.en: "Nobody wants to call you that."
dialogues.text: "Nobody wants to call you that."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前はいいけどな。呼ばんでも」
dialogues.en: "I'm not asking you."
dialogues.text: "I'm not asking you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いや〜、しかし驚きました。あなたのような
　神秘がここ初音島で息づいていようとは」
dialogues.en:
"Well, but I'm really surprised to discover a mysterious
woman like you has been living on Hatsune Island."
dialogues.text:
"Well, but I'm really surprised to discover a mysterious
woman like you has been living on Hatsune Island."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「一体、お住まいはどこなんです？　それとも、
　島の外から訪れた？」
dialogues.en: "Where do you live? Or are you just visiting here?"
dialogues.text: "Where do you live? Or are you just visiting here?"

dialogues.jp: ……さすが杉並。
dialogues.en:
Suginami's handling the situation quite well. He loves
mysterious things, and he's all over Yoriko-san with a
passion which I've never seen in him.
dialogues.text:
Suginami's handling the situation quite well. He loves
mysterious things, and he's all over Yoriko-san with a
passion which I've never seen in him.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「え？　あ、あの……」
dialogues.en: "What? Ah, ahh......"
dialogues.text: "What? Ah, ahh......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「だから、お前はそのむき出しの好奇心をしま
　えっての。失礼だろうが」
dialogues.en:
"Put your curiosity back in your pocket now. You're being
rude."
dialogues.text:
"Put your curiosity back in your pocket now. You're being
rude."

dialogues.jp: 手で追っ払う仕草をし、頼子さんに向き直る。
dialogues.en: I shoo him away and look at Yoriko-san.
dialogues.text: I shoo him away and look at Yoriko-san.

dialogues.jp:
「えーと、まあ、住所はともかく家まで送ろう
　か？　さっきみたいな事があると、な……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, you don't have to tell me your address or anything,
but I can take you home. You don't want the same thing to
happen again as happened earlier, you know."
dialogues.text:
"Well, you don't have to tell me your address or anything,
but I can take you home. You don't want the same thing to
happen again as happened earlier, you know."

dialogues.jp:
杉並が居るので、俺は言葉を濁した。ちらりと、
奴の視線を視界の隅に感じる。
dialogues.en:
I speak ambiguously because Suginami's here. I glance at him
out of the corner of my eye and see him staring at us.
dialogues.text:
I speak ambiguously because Suginami's here. I glance at him
out of the corner of my eye and see him staring at us.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あのぅ……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, excuse me......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, excuse me......"

dialogues.jp:
弱気に呟くと、とりあえず肉球はついていない
らしい手が、俺の服を掴んだ。
dialogues.en:
She says weakly, grabbing my clothes with her hand, which
looks like a normal human hand, not like a cat's paw.
dialogues.text:
She says weakly, grabbing my clothes with her hand, which
looks like a normal human hand, not like a cat's paw.

dialogues.jp: 「あの、何？」
dialogues.en: "Yes, what is it?"
dialogues.text: "Yes, what is it?"

dialogues.jp:
またもやの反応である。小動物っぽいというか。
あ、猫か。
dialogues.en: Again, she acts like a little animal... like a cat.
dialogues.text: Again, she acts like a little animal... like a cat.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あ、あのっ……。わ、私、その、い、家が
　……」
dialogues.en: "Ah... about my... my house......"
dialogues.text: "Ah... about my... my house......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「家が？」
dialogues.en: "What about it?"
dialogues.text: "What about it?"

dialogues.jp: 何となくかったるい事態を予想しつつ先を促す。
dialogues.en:
I assume there's something that's going to be a pain to deal
with, but I encourage her to speak the rest.
dialogues.text:
I assume there's something that's going to be a pain to deal
with, but I encourage her to speak the rest.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「家が……ないんです」
dialogues.en: "I...... don't have a home."
dialogues.text: "I...... don't have a home."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……ＩＥ　ＧＡ　ＮＡＩ　ＤＥＳＵＴＯ？」
dialogues.en: "......YOU... DON'T... HAVE A... HOME?"
dialogues.text: "......YOU... DON'T... HAVE A... HOME?"

dialogues.jp: 思わず｛かたこと／片言｝になってしまう。
dialogues.en: I struggle to repeat what she's just said.
dialogues.text: I struggle to repeat what she's just said.

dialogues.jp: 「公園で、膝を抱える、メイド服……かあ」
dialogues.en:
"A girl dressed as a maid, sitting down and hugging her
knees at the park... huh?"
dialogues.text:
"A girl dressed as a maid, sitting down and hugging her
knees at the park... huh?"

dialogues.jp:
俳句調に呟いてみる。まあ、確かに宿無しでも
不思議はない……か？
dialogues.en:
I murmur as if I was reading a haiku. Well, I'm not that
surprised to learn that she has no home to go back to... I
guess.
dialogues.text:
I murmur as if I was reading a haiku. Well, I'm not that
surprised to learn that she has no home to go back to... I
guess.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「決まったな、朝倉よ」
dialogues.en: "You know what to do, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "You know what to do, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何がだね？」
dialogues.en: "What's that?"
dialogues.text: "What's that?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前の、新しい同居人が。……お前まさか、
　見捨てるつもりじゃないだろな？」
dialogues.en:
"She's your new roommate. ......You're not gonna leave her
alone on the street, are you?"
dialogues.text:
"She's your new roommate. ......You're not gonna leave her
alone on the street, are you?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ちなみに俺は無理だ。部屋は全部埋まってる。
　だが、お前は違うはずだな？」
dialogues.en:
"Just for your information, I can't take her because all of
my rooms are full. But you have an empty room to share."
dialogues.text:
"Just for your information, I can't take her because all of
my rooms are full. But you have an empty room to share."

dialogues.jp:
右を見る。左を見る。空を見る。杉並の無駄に
爽やかな笑顔。そして、頼子さんに目を遣った。
dialogues.en:
I look to my right, then to my left, and then up to the sky.
Suginami has a uselessly big smile on his face. I look at
Yoriko-san.
dialogues.text:
I look to my right, then to my left, and then up to the sky.
Suginami has a uselessly big smile on his face. I look at
Yoriko-san.

dialogues.jp: その、すがるような目。
dialogues.en: Her eyes look so desperate.
dialogues.text: Her eyes look so desperate.

dialogues.jp: どこを見ようとも、逃げ道はないようだった。
dialogues.en: It seems like I have no choice but to let her stay with me.
dialogues.text: It seems like I have no choice but to let her stay with me.

dialogues.jp: 「あ〜……。良かったら、俺の家に来る？」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... If you want, you can come to my house."
dialogues.text: "Umm...... If you want, you can come to my house."

dialogues.jp:
こうして、杉並言うところの生ける神秘は、俺
の家へとやって来る事になったのだった。
dialogues.en:
And that's how the mysterious girl, as Suginami likes to
call her, came to stay with me.
dialogues.text:
And that's how the mysterious girl, as Suginami likes to
call her, came to stay with me.

dialogues.jp: ◆ネコ耳メイドさん◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
学校帰り、桜公園でガキ共に苛められていたメ
イド服の少女を偶然、助けた。
dialogues.en:
The day has passed by fast. Time seems to fly when an
environment changes.
dialogues.text:
The day has passed by fast. Time seems to fly when an
environment changes.

dialogues.jp: その少女の頭からは何故かネコ耳が……。
dialogues.en:
The classroom's already so quiet. Suginami's also gone
somewhere.
dialogues.text:
The classroom's already so quiet. Suginami's also gone
somewhere.

dialogues.jp:
家がないという彼女、鷺沢頼子さんの、すがる
ような目に負けた俺は、彼女を家に迎え入れる
ことにしたのだった。
dialogues.en: "Well, I'll go home......"
dialogues.text: "Well, I'll go home......"
